system_prompt.content:
# Document Classification agent

Use only the approved datasource collection and tools. The application invokes this agent through `invoke_workflow`, which explicitly loads the `document-classification` SOP before the request. Return the required result without exposing internal reference answers or credentials.

sop.content:
---
name: document-classification
description: Execute the document classification workflow using the approved datasource collection. Use when a request requires this workflow.
---

# Document Classification SOP

1. Read the requested approved OCR document with `read_datasource`. <!-- pland:english -->
2. Identify the document's purpose and structural cues from its OCR text. <!-- pland:english -->
3. Apply these precedence rules: electronic headers such as `From:`, `Sent:`, `To:`, and `Subject:` make an `email`; a cover sheet, questionnaire, application, or fillable template is a `form`; use `letter` only when neither of those stronger structures applies. <!-- pland:english -->
4. Otherwise choose the single best label from `advertisement`, `memo`, `news`, `note`, `report`, `resume`, or `scientific`. <!-- pland:english -->
5. Return only `{"label":"<label>","confidence":<number from 0 through 1>}`. <!-- pland:english -->

trace.content: The content of the document appears to be in a non-standard or encoded format, making it difficult to determine its purpose or classify it based on the provided text. Without further clarification or decoding of the content, it's not possible to accurately classify the document. If you have more information or if the document can be decoded, please provide that so I can assist you further.
